products.rain: NOAA/NWS Stage IV multi-sensor QPE (radar + gauge, ~4 km)
products.wind: NHC HURDAT2 best track, modified-Rankine profile fitted to the 34/50/64-kt radii; ×0.85 marine→open-terrain surface factor

flags.title: Hurricane wind + possible undetected flooding
flags.detail: Estimated 108 kt sustained wind (cat 3 hurricane-force). Radar reads the lot dry, but the pass came too late to rule out surge/flash flooding (see transient flag). Treat as a potential concurrent wind + water loss: inspect for interior water lines before allocating to wind.

flags.title: Transient flooding likely missed by SAR
flags.detail: 343 mm fell in 3 days (extreme), and the property sits 2.5 m above the nearest drainage line. The first post-event radar pass came 3.5 days after the peak — water that drained before then is invisible to radar. A dry reading here is not evidence of no loss.
